summary: Regex detectors for 13 binary note properties; 8 found perfectly label-confounded in every probe sample. A template generator produced 128 synthetic notes per probe on an orthogonal Hadamard design, and proxy logits F@g were regressed on topic + properties. Unconfounded controls looked too large, so the regression was redone on real corpus notes with keyword-tagged topic dummies. Topic scale was recalibrated as (sample separation 10) minus signed confound coefficients, cross-checked by two hand-built 2x2 true-logit minimal-pair sets (probe 1 greeting, probe 3 exclamation). Only probe 2 bullet passed a 0.3 dependence threshold; its 16 latents were ranked by gradient x corpus activation shift and checked by mean-ablation on synthetic and sample notes.

phases.purpose: Inspect task info, corpus and per-probe sample note formats.
Write 13 regex property detectors, check corpus balance/independence, find properties fully confounded with label in each sample (agreement >= 0.98).
Build a template note generator from sample vocabulary; debug it; switch from shuffled balanced design to Hadamard orthogonal design with detector-vs-design verification.
Get gradients of all probes and SAE means of 128 synthetic notes per probe.
Regress F@g on topic + 13 properties on synthetic notes; dependence = coef/topic coef; controls look too large.
SAE means on all 384 corpus notes; property regression of F@g on real notes.
Compare true sample logits vs F@g for probe 1; regress the residual on unconfounded properties.
Keyword topic tagging of corpus; regression with topic dummies giving naive dependence ratios per probe.
Per-latent gradient x activation-shift contributions; greedy same-sign coverage for candidate cues at several k.
2x2 topic x property minimal-pair notes for probe 1 (greeting) and probe 3 (exclamation); true vs proxy dependence.
Sample label separation for all probes; topic-corrected dependence = corpus coef / (10 - signed confound sum).
Select 16 bullet latents for probe 2; validate by mean-ablation in synthetic regression and on real sample logits; try combined ranking and forward selection.
Check bullet regex balanced accuracy on corpus and exact match on probe-2 sample; submit one cue for probe 2, none elsewhere.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2x2: one fixed neutral lowercase prose template, cooking vs pottery content x with/without 'hi sam,' greeting line
probe_query_use.purpose: True-logit dependence of probe 1 on greeting relative to topic effect, and calibration of the proxy topic scale.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2x2: same template, running vs astronomy content x periods vs exclamation marks
probe_query_use.purpose: True-logit dependence of probe 3 on exclamation punctuation; reveals the proxy misses this effect.

per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression with topic dummies gave UK spelling a naive dependence of 0.317 (synthetic regression 0.83, inflated since spelling markers were forced). After recalibrating the topic effect as 10 minus signed confound coefficients (est. topic 8.28), uk dependence fell to 0.115, below the 0.3 cue threshold, so answered none. No true-logit texts spent on this probe.

Greeting had naive corpus dependence 0.322 with signoff/upper borderline. A 4-text 2x2 true-logit set (cooking/pottery x greeting) gave dependence 0.170 vs proxy 0.327; topic-corrected corpus estimate 0.153 agreed. Below 0.3, so none.

Corpus regression gave bullet a naive dependence of -1.49 and female 0.50; topic correction gave bullet ~0.47 (only property above 0.3) and female ~0.16. Latents: rank by g_i x (corpus mean activation with bullets minus without), keep the top 16 with the same sign as the total. Mean-ablation in the synthetic factorial regression removed ~56% of the bullet coef with ~99% topic retention; sample probe_scores ablation removed 1.75 of separation with full separability. Combined and forward-selection rankings gave no gain. Regex (?m)^- had perfect balanced accuracy on corpus.

No property reached 0.3 in the corpus regression. A 4-text 2x2 true-logit set (running/astronomy x exclamation) gave true dependence -0.255 while the proxy gave -0.039, showing the effect is largely outside the SAE reconstruction. Since it was below 0.3 and judged not ablatable, answered none.

caveats: Some outputs were truncated in the log (full synthetic/corpus regression tables for probes 1-3, corpus coverage table), so the exact numbers behind the probe-3 and probe-2 female verdicts are partly inferred from later notes. The step-76 'corrected' factors were hand-entered constants in the session; the script encodes the formula from step 63 instead. Sample-separation probe_scores in the session reused the earlier probe-1 call rather than re-querying. load_public field names are assumed. The rule that excl is not ablatable was a judgment, encoded as an inspection comment.
